name: 40946-longprefill-31b-2gpu
model: google/gemma-4-31B-it, served unquantized at bfloat16, the checkpoint's own dtype.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; ~62 GB of bf16 weights is ~31 GB per card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bounded at 24 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. No warmup and no cooldown, so all 24 requests are scored.
workload: GuideLLM synthetic text, exactly 65000 prompt tokens and exactly 64 output tokens on every request, single turn, no shared prefix, EOS ignored, greedy decoding (temperature 0), request_format: plain against a completions endpoint.
purpose: A document analysis service summarizing book-length 65,000-token submissions into brief answers for eight concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.19.2rc0-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do
# not add keys from a later vLLM. Every value below is written out so a default cannot drift it.
model: google/gemma-4-31B-it
tensor-parallel-size: 2
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 131072
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
enable-prefix-caching: true
async-scheduling: true

# attention-backend is deliberately not pinned -- the engine selects for itself. Record which one
# it picks. quantization, kv-cache-dtype and --host/--port are likewise unset: bf16 weights with an
# unquantized KV cache, and the engine is built in-process so there is no HTTP server to configure.
